Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/2575/2020

Dear Mr. Rathore,

Thank you for meeting us on 5 August 2020 about your dispute with Radhika Pai. As we understand it, the cheque came back with the remark account closed.

Our advice is to treat the closure of the account as evidence of dishonest intent and oppose any compounding below the full cheque amount. Please collect the cheque, the return memo showing the account was closed and the loan agreement and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
